posts.text:
Yesterday (Fri Oct 30), Toronto streetcars spent 757 hours held up beyond a clean run.

Worst: 501 Queen westbound, a typical trip lost 37 min.
Smoothest: 512 St Clair westbound, 13 min lost.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Slowest segment yesterday: St Clair Station eastbound approaching Bay 1.
Each streetcar lost 124 s here on average, over 109 passes: 3.7 hours in all.
The signal here has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of St Clair Station around Bay 1, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the eastbound segment at Bay 1 is highlighted, peaking at about 124 seconds lost per streetcar.
